title: Charge Grid, 40 Minutes In
body:
This is Charge Grid after its first prompt iteration, about 40 minutes in.

It is currently my probable entry for [AI Jam 4](https://itch.io/jam/ai-jam-4). The early direction is an isometric power-grid builder about placing generation, balancing civic charge, and mixing energy sources as the grid grows.

I am testing three other project directions for the jam before I commit to one. I will probably share more of those soon.

![An early Charge Grid build showing an isometric grass grid with hand cranks, battery banks, coal, oil, nuclear, and solar power infrastructure, plus resource and civic-charge controls.](../media/charge-grid-2026-08-01-charge-grid-40-minutes-in/charge-grid-40-minutes-in.png)
